datasets.name: 5c75bc6f
queryLines:
SELECT `CST_GRP`,
--Chuyển dịch doanh số
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_TKS_MoMoi, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`)),2) as DS_TLCD_TKS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SLKH_MoMoi, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`)),2) as DS_TLCD_SLKH,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SLS_MoMoi, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY`)),2) as DS_TLCD_SLS,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch doanh số TKS
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`)),2) as DS_Per_DS_SoTo,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`)) 
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_YST` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_YST`)),2) as DS_Per_DS_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_MTD` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_MTD`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_PRE_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_PRE_MO`)),2) as DS_Per_DS_CKTT,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch khách hàng
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`)),2) as DS_Per_KH_SoTo,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`)) 
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_YST` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_YST`)),2) as DS_Per_KH_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_MTD` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_MTD`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_PRE_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_PRE_MO`)),2) as DS_Per_KH_CKTT,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch TKS mở mới
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY`)),2) as DS_Per_TKS_SoTo,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY`)) 
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_YST` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_YST`)),2) as DS_Per_TKS_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_MTD` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_MTD`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_PRE_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_PRE_MO`)),2) as DS_Per_TKS_CKTT,
-- Chuyển dịch số dư
    --Chuyển dịch số dư TKS mở mới
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL` ELSE 0 END) as SoDu_TKS_SoDu, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`CLS_BOOK_BAL`)),2) as SoDu_Per_TKS_SoDu,
    --Chuyển dịch khách hàng mở mới TKS
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as SoDu_KH, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY`)),2) as SoDu_Per_KH,
    --Chuyển dịch TKS mở mới
    SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as SoDu_TKS, 
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY`)),2) as SoDu_Per_TKS,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch số dư
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`CLS_BOOK_BAL`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL_LST_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`CLS_BOOK_BAL_LST_MO`)),2) as SoDu_Per_SoDu_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`CLS_BOOK_BAL`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL_LST_YR` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`CLS_BOOK_BAL_LST_YR`)),2) as SoDu_Per_SoDu_Prv_Year,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch khách hàng
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_LST_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_TVR_CST_LST_MO`)),2) as SoDu_Per_KH_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_TVR_CST_TDY`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_TVR_CST_LST_YR` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_TVR_CST_LST_YR`)),2) as SoDu_Per_KH_Prv_Year,
    --Tỷ lệ chuyển dịch TKS
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY`)),2) as SoDu_Per_TKS_SoTo,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_LST_MO` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_LST_MO`)),2) as SoDu_Per_TKS_Prv,
    round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_TDY`))
      - try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_LST_YR` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`NBR_OF_AC_W_BAL_LST_YR`)),2) as SoDu_Per_TKS_Prv_Year
FROM
  `mb_poc`.`gold`.`rpt_khcn_hdv_d09_dgtal_svg`
WHERE `CDR_DT`= :p_date AND (:p_sp is null or array_contains(:p_sp,`PD_TP`))
  AND (:p_khoi is null or array_contains(:p_khoi,`CST_LOB_NM`))
  AND (:p_phankhuc is null or array_contains(:p_phankhuc,`CST_GRP`))
  AND (:p_nhomtuoi is null or array_contains(:p_nhomtuoi,`GRP_AGE`))
group by `CST_GRP`

datasets.name: b22f93ec
queryLines:
SELECT `SUB_RGON`,`CST_GRP`,`TERM_TP`,`AR_RNG`, SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`) as Tong_DS, SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`) as SLKH, SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY`) as SLS, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_QUAY' AND `SPCL_INT_RATE_F` = 'N' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SP_Quay_LS_Thuong, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_QUAY' AND `SPCL_INT_RATE_F` = 'Y' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SP_Quay_LS_Hotline,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_QUAY' AND `SPCL_INT_RATE_F` = 'Y' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`)),2) as DS_SP_Quay_LS_TyLe_HotLine,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SP_So, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as SLKH_SP_So,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END) as DS_SP_So_SLS, 
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_TDY`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_DS,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_SLKH,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_TDY` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_TDY`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_SLS,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NEW_OPN_TVR_YST` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NEW_OPN_TVR_YST`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_DS_Prv_MO,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_YST` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_YST`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_SLKH_Prv_MO,
  round(try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `NBR_OF_NEW_AC_YST` ELSE 0 END) ,SUM(`NBR_OF_NEW_AC_CST_YST`)),2) as TyLe_ChuyenDich_SP_So_All_SLS_Prv_MO
    
FROM
  `mb_poc`.`gold`.`rpt_khcn_hdv_d09_dgtal_svg`
WHERE `CDR_DT`= :p_date  AND (:p_sp is null or array_contains(:p_sp,`PD_TP`))
  AND (:p_khoi is null or array_contains(:p_khoi,`CST_LOB_NM`))
  AND (:p_phankhuc is null or array_contains(:p_phankhuc,`CST_GRP`))
  AND (:p_nhomtuoi is null or array_contains(:p_nhomtuoi,`GRP_AGE`))
group by `SUB_RGON`,`CST_GRP`,`TERM_TP`,`AR_RNG`
ORDER BY `SUB_RGON`,`CST_GRP`,`TERM_TP`,`AR_RNG`

datasets.name: ff81d2bd
queryLines:
SELECT
  --DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `CDR_DT`) AS thoi_gian,
  date_format(`CDR_DT`, 'yyyy-MM') AS thoi_gian,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL`
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS tong_so_du_tiet_kiem_so,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN `PD_TP` = 'TGTK' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL`
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS tong_so_du_tiet_kiem,
  try_divide(
    100
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN `CHANNEL` = 'KENH_SO' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL`
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN `PD_TP` = 'TGTK' THEN `CLS_BOOK_BAL`
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
  ) AS ty_le_chuyen_dich
FROM
  `mb_poc`.`gold`.`rpt_khcn_hdv_d09_dgtal_svg`
WHERE
  `CLS_BOOK_BAL` IS NOT NULL
  AND year(`CDR_DT`) = year(:p_date)
GROUP BY
  --DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `CDR_DT`)
  date_format(`CDR_DT`, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY
  thoi_gian
